My tennis friends kept asking why I switched to pickleball 
Now they’re asking what paddle I use.

Here’s the thing - I didn’t realize how much easier pickleball would be on my body. No more tennis elbow. More court time. And the social scene? Unmatched.

But when I picked up CRBN’s TruFoam paddles, everything clicked.

✅ Power that rivals my tennis forehand
✅ Touch and control I couldn’t get with other paddles
✅ 100% foam core for consistency (no dead spots)
✅ Used by PPA Champions and tennis converts alike

Whether you’re exploring the switch or already hooked on pickleball, your paddle matters.

Discover why tennis players choose CRBN

Stop blaming the heat and start winning more rallies.

Get a grip on your game. 👇
